newsitem.title: UK: ICO says no Colombia coffee prices for time being.
newsitem.headline: ICO says no Colombia coffee prices for time being.

text.p: The International Coffee Organization (ICO) said on Thursday the group would not quote daily Colombian mild arabica prices for the time being.
An ICO official said this was because Colombia had closed its registration on coffee sales.
The price quotation would resume once Colombia reopens the registration, he said.
Colombia's National Coffee Growers' Federation said on April 14 it was closing registrations for May/June coffee shipments with immediate effect.
It did not elaborate. Traders said the decision was made after the current April/May/June registrations exceeded their quotas. --Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
